summary: US attacks on Iran continue with strikes on Revolutionary Guard headquarters near Rask, bridges and tunnels in Hormozgan, and ports including Bandar Abbas and Chabahar. Iran retaliated with missile and drone strikes on US bases in Jordan, Saudi Arabia, and Kuwait, marking its first direct attack on Saudi Arabia in nearly four months. Iranian health ministry reports at least 38 killed and over 400 wounded since fighting with the US resumed.
key_points: A Revolutionary Guard headquarters near the city of Rask was attacked and destroyed by the Americans, according to Iranian documentation (Source: @New_security8200/202713).
Two missiles struck the Muwaffaq Salti base in Jordan, where US forces are stationed (Source: @kianmeli1/89505).
US enemy attacks hit three bridges and a tunnel in Hormozgan including Shour river bridge and Mirzaei tunnel, with roads closed (Source: @VahidOnline/77221).
Iran attacked water desalination and electricity generation facilities in Kuwait, damaging multiple power generation units (Source: @asafroz/51568).
An Iranian ballistic missile was fired at a US base in Saudi Arabia, the first direct Iranian attack on Saudi Arabia in nearly four months (Source: @New_security8200/202718).
At least 38 people killed and over 400 wounded in Iran since resumption of fighting with the US per Iranian health ministry (Source: @asafroz/51556).
Israeli Air Force commander visited southern Lebanon to deepen operational cooperation between air and ground forces (Source: @New_security8200/202711).
US sending dozens of refueling aircraft to Israel ahead of possible resumption of fighting (Source: @amitsegal/63136).

sections.executive_summary: US attacks on Iran continue with strikes on Revolutionary Guard headquarters near Rask, bridges and tunnels in Hormozgan, and ports including Bandar Abbas and Chabahar. Iran retaliated with missile and drone strikes on US bases in Jordan, Saudi Arabia, and Kuwait, marking its first direct attack on Saudi Arabia in nearly four months. Iranian health ministry reports at least 38 killed and over 400 wounded since fighting with the US resumed.

points: A Revolutionary Guard headquarters near the city of Rask was attacked and destroyed by the Americans, according to Iranian documentation shared by the channel (Source: @New_security8200/202713).

US attacks on Hormozgan province killed three people and wounded eight others per an official in the province citing Tasnim; PressTV reported at least three civilians martyred and eight injured in latest US attacks on the southern province (Source: @New_security8200/202720, @presstv/199203).

US enemy attacks hit three bridges and a tunnel in Hormozgan: Mirzaei tunnel, Shour river bridge on Bandar Abbas-Sirjan route, and a bridge on Minab-Rudan road; roads closed and bypass efforts underway (Source: @VahidOnline/77221).
At 4:44 a point near Jask in Hormozgan was targeted by US military attack; details to be announced after initial assessment (Source: @SharghDaily/172698).
Bandar Abbas saw repeated explosions: two reported by PressTV, then about seven explosions 3:48-3:50 and Qeshm three explosions per received messages (Source: @presstv/199199, @VahidOnline/77223).

CENTCOM published footage of targeting the maritime control tower at Chabahar port; Lark island marine traffic control tower hit by missile per local reports (Source: @mamlekate/103930, @SharghDaily/172695).
Iranian rial fell to low of 1,918,000 per US dollar; UK formally listed Revolutionary Guards as illegal group under National Security Act 2026 (Source: @asafroz/51570, @mamlekate/103920).
IDF struck Khan Yunis and eliminated a Hamas company commander who participated in holding hostages and served as right-hand to senior organization figures (Source: @idf_telegram/24659).

A commander of the cooperation unit, Colonel A, visited the security sphere in southern Lebanon to deepen operational cooperation between Air Force and ground forces with professional dialogue (Source: @New_security8200/202711).
US sending dozens of refueling aircraft to Israel ahead of possibility of resumption of fighting (Source: @amitsegal/63136).

Several Israeli civilians crossed from Majdal Shams into Syria; located, detained, transferred to Israeli police; further attempts at southern Golan border prevented same day (Source: @idf_telegram/24661).
An interceptor was fired at a false target in southern Gaza Strip with no alerts activated per policy; incident under review (Source: @New_security8200/202707, @inon_yttach/9512).
Chief of Manpower Directorate sent letter to soldiers and commanders regarding extension of service to 32 months (Source: @inon_yttach/9513).
In a strike in Khan Yunis, a Hamas company commander who took part in holding hostages and was right-hand to senior organization figures was eliminated (Source: @idf_telegram/24659).
An interceptor was fired at a false target in southern Gaza Strip; no alerts activated per policy and no security event concern, incident under investigation (Source: @New_security8200/202707).
Indictment filed against terrorist who murdered Ido Zoldan in 2007; suspect released recently from PA custody, arrested in Qalqilya by IDF and Shin Bet (Source: @yediotnews25/132814).

Israeli civilians crossed from Majdal Shams into Syria and were returned; additional crossing attempts at southern Golan border prevented and suspects transferred to police (Source: @idf_telegram/24661).
In last 4 hours Beirut time 09:36-13:36, 43 alerts up 617% vs previous; 42 drones, 0 warplanes; most affected Nabatieh with 31 alerts (Source: @redlinkleb/31634).
Most monitored locations: Arnoun 4, Yahmar al-Shaqif 4, Zawtar al-Sharqiya 4, Nabatieh al-Fawqa 4, Nabatieh al-Tahta 4 alerts each (Source: @redlinkleb/31634).
Daily stats Friday 17 Jul 2026: total 112 alerts, 105 drone sightings; Mifdoun 12, Nabatieh al-Fawqa 11, Kfar Tibnit 11, Ali al-Tahir 10, Arnoun 10 (Source: @redlinkleb/31698).
Most active districts: Nabatieh 53, Bint Jbeil 17, Marjayoun 12; drone strikes 2 (Naqoura, Shoukin), air raid 1 (Mansouri), artillery 3 (Source: @redlinkleb/31698).

Israeli Air Force cooperation unit commander visited southern Lebanon security area to strengthen close air support and joint operational response with ground forces (Source: @New_security8200/202711).
Israeli civilians crossed from Majdal Shams into Syrian territory; IDF searched and returned them; further attempts at southern Golan border prevented (Source: @idf_telegram/24661).
Rased al-Ado channel stated Iran struck in the Indian Ocean, Kuwait, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, UAE, Bahrain, Iraq (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/378574).
Naya for Iraq shared footage of Iranian missile hitting US Muwaffaq Salti base in Jordan from another angle and reported failure of Patriot system (Source: @naya_foriraq/83821, @naya_foriraq/83801).
Explosions and alarm sirens reported in Bahrain per Naya for Iraq channel (Source: @naya_foriraq/83805).

Two missiles struck Muwaffaq Salti base in Jordan where US forces are stationed; Iran released footage of retaliatory drone attacks on US assets in Jordan and Kuwait (Source: @kianmeli1/89505, @presstv/199205).

Iran attacked water desalination and electricity facilities in Kuwait; Kuwait government said a desalination and power generation facility was hit and many power units damaged (Source: @asafroz/51568).
Iran fired a ballistic missile at a US base in Saudi Arabia, first direct Iranian attack on Saudi Arabia in nearly four months per senior US official (Source: @New_security8200/202718).
PressTV reported explosions at US bases in Saudi Arabia and Jordan per IRIB; Faytuks said Iranian missiles hit Muwaffaq Salti base in Jordan (Source: @presstv/199201, @Faytuks_Network/5086).
Two oil tankers exploded after hitting mined path south of Hormuz Strait per Sepah claim (Source: @kianmeli1/89489).
UKMTO received report of maritime incident off Yemen; unauthorized actors boarded vessel in Gulf of Aden (Source: @yediotnews25/132817).

key_developments: Revolutionary Guard headquarters near Rask was attacked and destroyed by US forces per Iranian documentation (Source: @New_security8200/202713).
Iran fired ballistic missile at US base in Saudi Arabia, first direct attack there in nearly four months per senior US official (Source: @New_security8200/202718).
Two missiles hit Muwaffaq Salti base in Jordan housing US forces; Iran released footage of drone strikes on US bases in Jordan and Kuwait (Source: @kianmeli1/89505).
Iran attacked water desalination and electricity facilities in Kuwait damaging many power generation units per Kuwait government (Source: @asafroz/51568).
US attacks on Hormozgan killed three and wounded eight per official; PressTV reported three martyred eight injured in province (Source: @New_security8200/202720).
US sending dozens of refueling aircraft to Israel ahead of possible resumption of fighting per correspondent (Source: @amitsegal/63136).
Advisor to Iran leader Mohsen Rezaei threatened total attack and destruction of enemy if US continues war in next 2-3 days (Source: @New_security8200/202714).
sections.threat_assessment: Iran has escalated to direct strikes on US bases across Jordan, Saudi Arabia, and Kuwait, with advisor Mohsen Rezaei threatening total attack and destruction if US war continues in next 2-3 days. US attacks on Iranian infrastructure including Rask HQ, Hormozgan bridges, Jask, Bandar Abbas, and Chabahar indicate sustained air campaign. The first Iranian ballistic missile on Saudi Arabia in four months and drone strikes on Kuwait facilities raise risk of regional energy disruption. Lebanese drone alerts surged 617% with 42 drones in four hours, signaling continued cross-border pressure.
sections.regional_response: Kuwait confirmed damage to desalination and power facilities and reported multiple power units hit. UK formally listed Iran's Revolutionary Guards as illegal threat under National Security Act 2026. US is deploying dozens of refueling aircraft to Israel anticipating possible fighting resumption. Jordan and Saudi bases were struck with Iran publishing retaliation footage, while UKMTO reported unauthorized boarding off Yemen in Gulf of Aden.
sections.intelligence_notes: Iranian health ministry claims at least 38 killed and over 400 wounded since fighting with US resumed, while Hormozgan official cites three killed eight wounded from US attacks. CENTCOM published footage of Chabahar maritime tower strike and Lark island control tower was hit per local reports. Rial fell to 1,918,000 per dollar indicating economic stress. Faytuks Network conducted satellite analysis of damage to several US bases across Middle East from Iranian strikes.
